ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with approximately <10% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity dark grey/black pigment across both lobes. A localized high-intensity white patch is visible at the distal tip of the left lobe. Distributed circular low-contrast ring patterns are present across the surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration profile. Multiple sharp peaks and valleys (3-8 pixels in amplitude) are distributed across the entire trailing edge span of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex sweep from the median notch to the tips, with a pronounced upward curvature at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular ring-like pixel clusters (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) distributed across the central and outer regions of both lobes. Dense, brownish-tan high-relief clusters (barnacles) are present at both distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, vertically oriented high-contrast linear marks visible on the upper portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy colonization of barnacles at the distal tips of both lobes, creating an irregular physical profile. Numerous circular scars (rosettes) present across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density of barnacle growth at the fluke tips creates a unique, highly irregular terminal geometry.
